import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest.mock
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import execution_spec as S, execution_receipt as R
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve()
try:
    home = tmp / "home"; home.mkdir()
    repo = tmp / "repo"; repo.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "t@example.invalid"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "t"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    (repo / ".gitignore").write_text(".tasks/\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "README.md").write_text("hi\n", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-qm", "init"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    cj = home / ".claude.json"
    cj.write_text(json.dumps({"numStartups": 1, "caches": {"k": "v1"}, "mcpServers": {"s1": {"command": "a"}}, "projects": {"X": {"lastCost": 1, "mcpServers": {}}}}), encoding="utf-8")
    with unittest.mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"HOME": str(home)}):
        s0 = R.protected_snapshot(str(repo))
        cj.write_text(json.dumps({"numStartups": 99, "caches": {"k": "v2"}, "mcpServers": {"s1": {"command": "a"}}, "projects": {"X": {"lastCost": 5, "history": ["h"]}, "Y": {"mcpServers": {}}}}), encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) == s0, "counter/cache/project state change must not alter snapshot"
        cj.write_text(json.dumps({"numStartups": 99, "mcpServers": {"s1": {"command": "a"}, "s2": {"command": "b"}}, "projects": {"X": {"mcpServers": {}}}}), encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) != s0, "top-level mcpServers addition must alter snapshot"
        cj.write_text(json.dumps({"numStartups": 99, "mcpServers": {"s1": {"command": "a"}}, "projects": {"X": {"mcpServers": {"p1": {"command": "c"}}}}}), encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) != s0, "projects.X.mcpServers addition must alter snapshot"
        cj.write_text(json.dumps({"numStartups": 99, "hooks": {"PreToolUse": ["x"]}, "mcpServers": {"s1": {"command": "a"}}}), encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) != s0, "hooks addition must alter snapshot"
        cj.write_text("{not valid json", encoding="utf-8")
        u1 = R.protected_snapshot(str(repo))
        assert u1 != s0, "parsable to unparsable must differ"
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) == u1, "identical unparsable bytes must match"
        cj.write_text("{other invalid json", encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) != u1, "modified unparsable bytes must differ"
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
print("ok")
